Rearchitecting the Data Platform for the AI Era

Chief information officers who build enterprise data platforms with the right architecture, operating model, and sequencing for artificial intelligence workloads can create a lasting competitive edge.

A platform designed for changing AI workloads

The architecture should make trusted data available across analytical and operational use cases while preserving governance. A clear operating model connects platform teams with domain owners, and disciplined sequencing prevents expensive infrastructure work from getting too far ahead of business demand.
